answer: Each new identity must post a bond and solve a randomly assigned proof before joining the reward pool. A public beacon chooses a small route puzzle; peers record a marble-sized fingerprint of the signed result, then three established reviewers check it independently. The network compares each agent’s pulse of work across epochs and burns the bond when linked accounts recycle answers. At 10 tokens per account, a farm of 500 fakes ties up 5,000 tokens and owes 1,500 attestations before earning anything. It turns a Sybil voyage into a bridge toll paid at every crossing.
